name: Wataya Azusa
source:
Favorite series: [url=/p172]Cuffs[/url].
Favorite character: [url=/c39397]Sera Karen[/url].

Azusa is a second year high school student and classmates with [url=/c75371]Rio[/url], [url=/c77305]Takuto[/url] and [url=/c75586]Kyouya[/url]. She's also [url=/c75370]Nana[/url]'s childhood and best friend. A model student and the representative of the class, Azusa is admired by the majority of her classmates, seeing her as a perfect girl with a perfect reputation... something she wants to keep that way. That's why Azusa wants to keep the fact that she's obsessed with CUFFS Story's (Nana is the only one who knows) and her love for moe characters a secret because it could damage her reputation. That's why she often takes time off during breaks to play the game with Nana on the school's roof.
